name: Replit

sources.title: Replit docs index — publish flows, Replit Apps, Free Mode, cloud services
Batch-provided signup URL — replit.com returns 403 to non-browser fetchers

conditions: Account creation is free and a Free Mode allowance exists for building

Publishing an app to a live public URL is a 'publish/deploy' action — docs cover release settings and monitoring; ongoing hosting may consume plan credits or require a paid tier (not fully verifiable from fetched pages)
requirements: A Replit account (replit.com/signup — 403 to automated fetches, use a browser)
The 'listing' is a public Replit profile plus published Apps/sites — there is no directory submission form
Docs describe a publish workflow: build with Agent or import a project, choose release settings, publish, verify the live version
preparation: A small public app or project to publish (landing page, demo tool) — an empty profile has no launch value
Display name/bio and website URL for the public profile
workflow: Sign up at https://replit.com/signup in a browser
Create a Project (import code or build with Agent in Free Mode)
Use the publish flow (docs.replit.com/build/publish-your-app): pick release settings, publish, verify the live URL
The published app's replit.app URL and the public profile together form the destination footprint
watchFor: replit.com blocks automated fetches (403) — signup and pricing pages could not be verified directly
Replit has pivoted toward an agent/build product; older 'community gallery' assumptions may not hold
Publishing/deploying can incur cloud costs — check plan limits before promising a free listing
Do not represent an unpublished draft project as live
countsAsLive: A public app URL (replit.app domain or connected domain) serves the published build, and the owner's public Replit profile shows the project
unknowns: Whether a permanent free published-URL tier exists under current (Aug 2026) cloud billing
Whether Replit still operates a browsable public gallery/directory
